author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Gameplay Trailer for SilkRoad Project, an anime action roguelike management game developed by Guedin. Players will engage in flashy combo-based combat, controlling two characters at one time, alongside managing a bustling guesthouse to ensure guests are comfortable. SilkRoad Project is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: SilkRoad Project - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Launch Trailer for Before I Go, a Metroidvania action-adventure dark fantasy game developed by J's Laboratory. Players will overcome platforming obstacles and combat engagements as the embodiment of the innocence a child wields in the great struggle of accepting death. Before I Go is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
title: Before I Go - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Blood Reaver is available now in PC Early Access. Take a look at brutal gameplay, weapons, and more from Blood Reaver in this early access launch trailer for the dark-fantasy, round-based FPS. Become the Blood Reaver in solo or 4-player co-op. Harness forbidden magic and weaponry to shoot, blast and slice your way through endless hordes of demons. Upgrade your arsenal and survive long enough to discover the ancient secrets of the gods of hell.
title: Blood Reaver - Official Early Access Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the 'What Exactly is Wuxia' Behind the Scenes Video for Phantom Blade Zero, an upcoming dark fantasy action RPG developed by S-Game Studio. Hear straight from the director of Phantom Blade Zero, Soulframe Liang, on the process behind portraying the Wuxia elements in the game. From the distinct fighting styles to the authentic kung fu inclusions, S-Game is setting out to bring a Wuxia-inspired experience to the upcoming title. Phantom Blade Zero is launching on September 9 for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Phantom Blade Zero - Official 'What Exactly is Wuxia' Behind the Scenes Video

author: GameTrailers
description: A master potter arrives in hell under mysterious circumstances. With your skills, you must craft pieces for the inhabitants of the underworld. Survive, improve your creations, meet new neighbours, and try to uncover the mysteries of the depths. Watch the Greda Inferno announcement trailer for this upcoming crafting sim game. Greda Inferno will be available on PC.
title: Greda Inferno - Official Announcement Trailer

description: Watch the latest Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss trailer to see what to expect with the PS5 features, including 3D Audio, DualSense haptics, and adaptive triggers that connect you to your investigative tools in this adventure game. title: Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss - Official PS5 Features Trailer

The duo partners of self-proclaimed "Spirit Agent" accept various supernatural commissions and use a full set of ghost-hunting techniques to tackle urban myths caused by lingering ghosts in the city of Riverrun. Ghost Hunting Journal will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam.
title: Ghost Hunting Journal - Official Trailer

Don't miss the Absolute Batman Reveal Trailer for LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight, an upcoming installment in the LEGO Batman franchise developed by TT Games. Players can take a look at the reveal for the latest suit, the Absolute Batman suit, based on the Absolute Batman comic series. Become the Absolute Batman in LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight, launching on May 22 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).

#LEGOBatmanLegacyOfTheDarkKnight #AbsoluteBatman #IGN

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the Blood Mall: Retaped upgrades trailer for this upcoming short first-person dinosaur horror game inspired by creature features of the 80s, and the works of Puppet Combo. The new trailer showcases the upgrades compared to the original version of the game. Take control of a big game hunter-turned-rookie cop, sent to deal with a prehistoric threat that has turned the Dayton County Mall into a blood-soaked hell. Use your trusty (but shockingly outdated) shotgun and survive the mall, finding survivors along the way and piecing together the events that caused the massacre.

Blood Mall: Retaped is a complete overhaul of the original game, with vastly improved visuals, new blood and gore systems, new content, and more extras!

Blood Mall: Retaped will be available on PC on April 22, 2026.
title: Blood Mall: Retaped - Official Upgrades Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Playtest Launch Trailer for Roguebound Pirates, a pirate-themed action roguelike inventory management game developed by Redbeak Games. Players will embark on an adventure fit for a pirate with a suite of weapons, upgrades to attain, and loot to claim for the taking. Roguebound Pirates is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a playtest available now on Steam.
title: Roguebound Pirates - Official Playtest Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Announcement Trailer for Danger Sticks, a fast-paced first-person stickman shooter developed by Use Map Settings. Players will embody a silhouette of destruction by taking up arms and fighting across prototype-style levels of real-world locations. Make use of the Nostalgia mechanic to slow down time, prioritize targets for maximum efficiency, and enter a flow state to reign down carnage. Danger Sticks is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Danger Sticks - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the announcement trailer for Necrofall, a fast-paced first-person melee roguelike where you play as an undead skeleton fighting through ever-changing dungeons. Combat is skill-driven, with a focus on precision, timing, impactful hits, and build-defining upgrades that create chaotic, emergent combat moments. Necrofall is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Necrofall - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's your look at the Spinning Scarecrow announcement trailer for this upcoming twisted new arcade puzzle game. In Spinning Scarecrow, take control of a constantly rotating scarecrow, navigating tight, trap-filled environments where every second and every angle matters. One wrong move can mean instant failure. Set in a surreal, ink-drenched, hand-drawn world, players must guide their spinning form through claustrophobic mazes, dodging deadly obstacles and adapting to ever-changing hazards. Spinning Scarecrow will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam.
title: Spinning Scarecrow - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Layers of Fear: The Final Masterpiece Edition trailer for this horror adventure game collection. Layers of Fear: The Final Masterpiece Edition features Layers of Fear, Layers of Fear 2, and all released DLC, along with new chapters that tie every story together. Layers of Fear: The Final Masterpiece Edition is available now digitally on Nintendo Switch 2, and a physical edition will be available on September 18, 2026.
title: Layers of Fear: The Final Masterpiece Edition - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Trailer

Explore a sprawling facility to take out enemies amongst cargo containers, a massive ship, and an offshore facility to engage the enemy. The Akh Canal Warfare Map launches with Season Echo for Delta Force on April 21 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, iOS, Android, and PC.
title: Delta Force - Official Akh Canal Warfare Map Reveal Trailer

description: Take a look at the Weather Condition Trailer for Tour de France 2026, an upcoming cycling racing game developed by Cyanide Studios. Mind speeds on the track when the roads are still saturated from the recent rainfall. Tour de France 2026 is launching on June 4 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

For Hire is launching on April 16 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).

description:
Laufey takes the spotlight in the latest Fortnite Festival trailer. Watch the Fortnite Festival trailer to see what's coming with Season 14, which features the music artist Laufey. Season 14 of Fortnite Festival begins on April 16, 2026. 

The Season 14 Emberlight Music Pass, included for all Fortnite Crew members, grants immediate access to the White Dress Laufey Outfit. title: Fortnite Festival - Official Season 14: Laufey Trailer

Pattern Ring is coming soon to PC (Steam).

description: Check out the 0.6 Update Launch Trailer for Assetto Corsa EVO, the hit racing simulation game developed by KUNOS Simulazioni. title: Assetto Corsa EVO - Official 0.6 Update Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: No Stone Unturned follows the story of amnesiac squirrel gumshoe Detective Cox, as he investigates the mysterious death of a chicken found on the side of the road, in the small town of Orchard-Under Hill. Armed with a magnifying glass, tape recorder, and crowbar, players will explore Orchard-Under Hill, interview the residents, collect clues, and piece together the evidence to solve the mystery - all while playing through fast-paced, bite-sized minigames. Take a look at gameplay from No Stone Unturned in this latest trailer for the upcoming comedy detective mystery game. The first case for No Stone Unturned will be available on PC in Steam Early Access on April 29, 2026.
title: No Stone Unturned - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
The woods are lovely, dark and deep, but there’s a Grail to reach and battles to win before you sleep…Take a look at gameplay from Grail in this trailer for the upcoming fantasy deckbuilder where your deck fights for you. Grail will be available on PC in 2026. A demo is out now on Steam.

In Grail, travel through the woods, upgrading your deck, finding synergies and sharpening your strategy. Take on foes in pitched card battles that play out automatically before your eyes. At the end of each day you’ll test your deck building prowess against another player. Stack wins together and climb your way from lowly blade-for-hire to a master of the auto-battling arts!
title: Grail - Official Announcement Trailer

description: Don't Lose Aggro is available now in Steam Early Access. Watch the Don't Lose Aggro early access launch trailer for this single-player action roguelite inspired by MMO raids. title: Don’t Lose Aggro - Official Early Access Launch Trailer

#LEGOFortnite #Gaming #IGN

#Pragmata #Gaming #IGN

description:
Get another look at Total Chaos in this latest trailer for the survival horror game. Fort Oasis is no paradise—it's a decaying nightmare where reality crumbles. The creator of Turbo Overkill unleashes survival-horror stacked with mysteries and monstrosities. Scavenge to craft weapons, while a voice on your walkie-talkie guides you into the island's depths. Total Chaos will be available on Nintendo Switch 2 on April 29, 2026. It is also out now on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S.

#TotalChaos #Gaming #IGN

author: GameTrailers
description:
Dread Neighbor gets a new trailer and a release date announcement. Watch the Dread Neighbor release date trailer for this upcoming first-person psychological horror game and sequel to Dread Flats. Dread Neighbor will be available on Windows PC via Steam on May 7, 2026.

In Dread Neighbor, you are a young woman who moves into a cheap, new apartment to save money. But something is wrong. From the closets, under the bed, through the cracks in the walls—you are being watched. Every corner feels alive with an unseen presence.
title: Dread Neighbor - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
TerraTech Legion gets a new trailer and a release date announcement. Watch the TerraTech Legion trailer for this upcoming bullet heaven builder game. In TerraTech Legion, build the ultimate battle vehicle and rage against the machines in a Survivors-like vehicular action roguelike. TerraTech Legion will be available on Steam, Xbox Series X|S, Microsoft Store for Windows, and Epic Games Store on April 30, 2026. It will also be available day one with Xbox Game Pass Ultimate and Xbox Game Pass PC.

#TerraTechLegion #Gaming #IGN

description: Check out the trailer for Expedition: The Cult, an upcoming first-person survival horror action-adventure game. Expedition: The Cult will be available on PC.
